implementation: AutoSaddler V2 0.2.0 with captured pre-existing local Windows compatibility patches; reference paper used V1

historical_acp_pilot.model_transport: Codex ACP 2.5.0 with typed action-selection MCP; OpenCode executes all task tools
historical_acp_pilot.scope: Bounded pilot, not full benchmark replication; no API fallback or purchased top-up

recommended_design.target_harnesses: One shared OpenCode harness, evaluated on several benchmarks
recommended_design.optimizer_transport: OpenCode ACP in an isolated Docker workspace; implemented in optimizer_provider.py
recommended_design.interpretation: AutoSaddler applied to OpenCode with multi-benchmark evaluation; reproduction of the method, not the original paper's harness-specific results
recommended_design.model_provider: OpenCode-provided models; exact service, plan and available allowance must be verified
recommended_design.candidate_status: Supersedes the earlier OpenRouter model shortlist; freeze model IDs and parameters before baseline

terminal_bench_2.exact_split_ids: Not present in the local upstream checkout; must obtain or disclose a replacement split

experiment_design.baseline: H0: pinned OpenCode version, configuration, prompts, tools and skills
experiment_design.optimized: H1: ONE immutable candidate selected using development scores only
experiment_design.optimization: One AutoSaddler search on a predeclared balanced mixture of benchmark train sets; no independent per-benchmark winners in the main table
experiment_design.development_selection: Macro-average of per-benchmark development success rates, with fixed weights
experiment_design.evaluation: Evaluate exactly H0 and the same H1 on identical held-out task IDs, repeats, model IDs, decoding parameters, tools and resource ceilings
experiment_design.adaptation: Benchmark-specific environment adapters are fixed before baseline and shared by H0 and H1; never use benchmark IDs to select different optimized configurations
experiment_design.search_space: Freeze a writable-path manifest before paid search. Prompt/config/tool/skill edits are distinct from OpenCode source/loop edits; report actual scope and preserve capability/steering phases where applicable.

benchmarks.terminal_bench_2: First integration target: check Harbor OpenCode support and pin adapter/version
benchmarks.swe_bench_pro: Second integration target: fixed repository task adapter plus official patch evaluator; pin the paper-era dataset version
benchmarks.gaia2: Required benchmark. Tool transport verified on a real train scenario with OpenCode 1.19.5; full events/time/judge adapter remains to implement. See gaia2_compatibility.json.

experiment_design.claims: The main experiment measures joint multi-task improvement. A claim of transfer requires an additional predeclared benchmark excluded from optimization.

token_accounting.unit: One API request with immutable run/candidate/task/repeat IDs
token_accounting.no_double_count: Cached and reasoning counters may be subsets of input/output; preserve provider semantics and never blindly add all counters
token_accounting.include: All billed attempts, auxiliary/subagent calls, accepted and rejected candidates, failures and retries
token_accounting.unknown_usage: Record null with coverage status when usage is missing; never silently convert unknown usage to zero
token_accounting.search_cost: Report optimizer tokens AND target agent train/dev tokens separately, plus judge tokens; all three contribute to optimization cost
token_accounting.final_cost: Report H0 and H1 held-out inference tokens separately for each benchmark; include tokens per attempted task and per solved task
token_accounting.shared_run: Optimizer totals belong to the shared optimization_run_id and are counted once; per-benchmark attribution is optional and must document its rule
token_accounting.subscription: Record provider monetary cost and allowance consumed separately from subscription cash price; included requests still consume tokens/quota

budget_usd.status: OpenCode subscription/allowance budget; the old OpenRouter allocations are superseded
budget_usd.enforcement_status: Native Go Plus OAuth proxy with per-role allowance/request reserves and rolling/weekly/monthly quota checks; no top-up or alternate provider
budget_usd.policy: Use explicit provider/model IDs; no automatic provider fallback or top-up. Count optimizer, train/dev target, final target and judge usage separately.

sizing_rule.calibrate_on: train/dev only; no test-driven model or hyperparameter selection
sizing_rule.iteration_upper_bound_rollouts: 2 * batch_size + dev_size (assuming the patch is accepted)
sizing_rule.cost_rule: Reserve paired final evaluation first. Then choose iterations from remaining money using measured optimizer, agent, judge and retry costs, with a safety margin.
sizing_rule.tiny_pilot_warning: One or two iterations may not exercise both patch phases and cannot establish paper-level search behavior or generalization.

paper_cost_evidence.scope: GAIA2 only; do not extrapolate these averages to other benchmarks

current_terminal_pilot.quota_guard: Stop before new calls when any rolling/weekly/monthly usage reaches 70%; no automatic retries or provider fallback
current_terminal_pilot.request_limits: 200000 UTF-8 serialized bytes; maximum 8192 output tokens; conservative allowance reservation before each call
current_terminal_pilot.billing: Require native Go Plus billing and balance cost zero in every response. Existing account Extra Usage setting has not been inspected or changed; quota guards keep calls away from exhaustion.
current_terminal_pilot.calibration_limits: One representative task and one synthetic-scoring optimizer cycle establish connectivity, not a guaranteed upper bound on hard-task usage.
current_terminal_pilot.failure_policy: Stop on infrastructure/API/usage errors, preserve traces and usage; never convert them into valid zero rewards. A budget-limited partial run is not reported as a completed experiment.
current_terminal_pilot.interpretation: Bounded V2/OpenCode method pilot, not original paper results. Local seeded split, different models and harness; no final test outcomes consulted during design.

changes: Only native AgentTimeoutError with verified process cleanup and official verifier reward is a valid task outcome. Other exceptions remain errors.
Stop the active command and its descendant processes before verification. Preserve background services left by already completed tool calls.
Previous requests and allowance remain charged against role and global caps.
Go provider usage is authoritative for total tokens, including requests interrupted at agent timeout.
recovery.restart_reason: Adapter lifecycle changed; initial development is measured again under the corrected version. Prior measurements remain diagnostic and their costs remain included.
